note: Sac County, IA publishes its zoning districts only as a static PDF map (zoning_map_50778.pdf). No queryable ArcGIS/WFS/OGC zoning layer found for the county. Its Beacon parcel viewer shows no zoning service. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online for Sac County zoning and Sac City, Lake View and Odebolt zoning found no district layers. The ISU Iowa zoning guide holds only city boundaries and centroids, not districts.
